question: Should this draft Policy doctor preview stack proceed after the docs/proof gaps are fixed, or should maintainers hold it until the Gateway predecessor and alsoAllow follow-up are reviewed together?
rationale: The PR changes operator-facing repair output for security/config policy checks and carries a protected maintainer label, so automation should not decide the stack/product acceptance alone.

options.title: Fix docs and proof first
options.body: Require agent/tool Policy Repair docs plus redacted real output proving skipped preview behavior before maintainer review of the stack.

options.title: Accept source-only proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the tests and PR explanation as enough proof, but the actual CLI rendering remains unproven.

options.title: Hold for stack review
options.body: Keep this PR paused until the predecessor and follow-up policy preview PRs can be reviewed as one stack.

recommendation.title: Fix docs and proof first
recommendation.body: Require agent/tool Policy Repair docs plus redacted real output proving skipped preview behavior before maintainer review of the stack.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent main commit owns the localized Policy doctor and repair-flow surfaces that define the stack's current review boundary.
